description: Visual polish: redesign the dashboard topbar (priority) and a light consistency pass on dashboard headings/spacing. Keep the semantic-class CSS approach (no Tailwind utility conversion). Preserve ALL topbar functionality (mobile nav toggle, notifications dropdown, theme toggle, role pill, 'welcome back' greeting) and do not regress builder/studio iframe layouts. Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (CSS + light markup only).
steps: In src/app/globals.css restyle the topbar block: .topbar (cleaner height ~72px, refined border-bottom, subtle shadow, improved backdrop-blur, correct sticky z-index), .topbar-left/.topbar-actions (tighter alignment + spacing), .topbar-kicker (muted uppercase label), .topbar-title (clearer weight/size hierarchy, breadcrumb-like treatment), .role-pill and .role-pill.admin (modern rounded pill with dot, good contrast), .icon-button + .theme-toggle-button + .notification (consistent 36px sizing, hover states). Keep every existing class name; you may ADD modifier classes but must not remove classes the component relies on.
Ensure dark mode: update/extend `.dark .topbar` and add dark variants for .role-pill / icon buttons so contrast is correct in dark mode (dark mode is toggled via a `.dark` class on an ancestor).

Preserve responsive behavior: the existing @media (max-width:760px) hides .role-pill and .topbar-kicker and shows .mobile-menu; @media (max-width:540px) shrinks .topbar-title and icon buttons. Verify these still apply after the restyle; adjust only if the redesign needs it, keeping the mobile menu button visible and functional under 760px.

In src/components/dashboard-shell.tsx, keep all behavior and handlers intact. Only adjust topbar markup if needed for the new styling (e.g. wrapping title/kicker). Do NOT remove the mobile-menu button, notifications dropdown, ThemeToggle, role-pill, or greeting.

Light consistency pass: in globals.css refine .page-heading / .eyebrow / .content-page spacing for a cleaner, consistent look across dashboard pages. Do NOT redesign individual pages and do NOT touch the landing/template studio layouts or their preview iframes (.landing-studio, .studio-code, .studio-preview, srcDoc/sandbox iframes).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run lint` exits 0 and `npm run build` succeeds.
Topbar retains a working mobile menu toggle, notifications dropdown, theme toggle, role pill, and greeting (verified by reading dashboard-shell.tsx — no handler or element removed).
Topbar styling is defined for both light and `.dark` modes and the 760px/540px media rules still target the topbar elements.
Builder/studio preview iframes and layouts are unchanged (no edits to landing-pages/create or templates/create structure or their iframe sandbox attributes).
Styling remains semantic-class CSS in globals.css (no conversion to Tailwind utility classes).
verification: Re-read src/components/dashboard-shell.tsx to confirm mobile-menu button, notification-wrap dropdown, ThemeToggle, role-pill, and the greeting are all still present and wired to their handlers.
findings: Pure CSS + minimal markup. Topbar restyled in globals.css: slimmer 72px bar, saturate/blur backdrop, subtle border+shadow, z-index 30, tighter action spacing (10px), .topbar-heading wrapper for title/kicker with truncation, clearer title weight/size (15px, -.3px tracking), muted uppercase kicker, modern role-pill with glowing dot and transition, icon-button/theme-toggle hover now add soft bg+shadow. Added .dark variants for .topbar, icon/theme hover, and both .role-pill states. Light consistency pass: .page-heading/.eyebrow spacing bumped and description line-height added, .content-page gap 22->24px. Only markup change in dashboard-shell.tsx: wrapped the existing kicker+title <div> with className='topbar-heading' (no handlers/elements removed). Verified: mobile-menu toggle, notifications dropdown, ThemeToggle, role-pill, greeting all intact; 760px/540px media rules still target topbar elements. Builder/studio iframes untouched. npm run lint exits 0, npm run build succeeds.
